responsibility: Implements tree-level computation and propagation of __builtin_object_size results. It analyzes object bases, subobjects, offsets, flexible-array initial sizes, alloc-like calls, pointer arithmetic, PHI/SSA expressions, and loop-carried additions to infer upper or lower bounds for object and subobject size kinds, caches results per SSA name, and drives both early and normal GIMPLE passes that fold or strengthen __builtin_object_size calls for diagnostics, fortification, and optimization.
same_name_distinction: Implements the object-size analysis APIs declared in gcc/tree-object-size.h. Unlike the header’s exported queries and mode constants, this file contains the dataflow and SSA-based computation of builtin object sizes plus the early and normal GIMPLE passes that fold or strengthen __builtin_object_size calls.
